detailed_descriptions.en: By using the unreal engine 5, your journey of conquest will be more than ordinary. You will fully experience and immerse yourself in the violent beauty of blood and fire. Greedland 1.0 is officially LIVE! Unleash new Power Armor, fresh gear, and devastating weapons as you plunge into the uncharted Lava Area for an unparalleled killing spree! Plus, the all-new Mecha Mode empowers you to dominate the battlefield! Massive content awaits. What are you waiting for, warrior? Report to the Armory, claim your new Power Armor, and forge a path of blood and fire! Hordes of monsters crash down on you, exploding into crimson mist with every shot. Missiles rain, cannons roar, and lasers paint the sky! Unleash extreme firepower to incinerate every enemy in your path. Millions of monstrosities across dozens of levels eye you hungrily. Retreat? Never! Blast right through them! Forge your throne of victory with blood and fire! Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the stunning visual fidelity delivers a symphony of gunfire and an unforgettable feast for your eyes. l Surrounded by monsters? Running low on ammo? Your Titan Mechas are always on standby, ready to deploy. With a brutal aesthetic and overwhelming firepower, they'll crush everything in their path. Bosses or elite foes? They're just minor speed bumps on your rampage. The collision of steel and flesh is always exhilarating! Auxiliary gear combined with mech upgrades transforms you into a mobile meat grinder, making the monsters remember the terror of humanity's wrath! Welcome to the Armory, warrior! Here, your firepower will undergo radical evolution! Each Power Armor boasts unique upgrades—there's always one to suit your playstyle. A vast arsenal of chips will supercharge your combat, combining with over 300 upgrades to maximize the adrenaline rush of every encounter. Mix and match diverse auxiliary equipment to create unique experiences each run, and even synthesize ultimate gear to utterly dominate the battlefield! Feeling lonely fighting bugs by yourself? "I'm here to help!" The online co-op system is officially live! Grab a buddy, it's bug-slaying time! Double the firepower, double the challenge, and more than double the satisfaction! What are you waiting for? Bring your best mercenary down! 【Currently supports 2-player online co-op, 4-player co-op is still in development!】 Greedland's achievements today are inseparable from every single supporter! We will continue to listen to our players, drawing inspiration from you and returning value to you. We'll strive for continuous updates, so stay tuned for more exciting content!
